description: This file defines the RecurrenceRule class used for representing and computing recurrence schedules, including parsing rules from a database entity, validating dates against recurrence rules, and calculating the next occurrence. It encapsulates logic for various recurrence patterns like daily, weekly, monthly, etc., with supporting constants and utility methods.

classes.name: RecurrenceRule
classes.description: Represents recurrence rules for scheduling with methods for initialization, validation, and next occurrence calculation.

methods.name: RecurrenceRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule object from a GenericValue entity, validating entity name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the recurrence rule by validating its frequency and parsing constituent lists.

methods.name: checkFreq
methods.description: Validates if the frequency string is among accepted values.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves the end timestamp for the recurrence, if specified.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Gets the total number of occurrences for the recurrence or 0 if unlimited.

methods.name: getFrequencyName
methods.description: Returns the recurrence frequency as an uppercase string.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the recurrence frequency as an internal constant.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the interval value for recurrence spacing.

methods.name: getIntervalInt
methods.description: Retrieves the interval as an integer.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next occurrence time after the provided start and from times, considering end time and count constraints.

methods.name: validCurrent
methods.description: Checks whether the current recurrence period is valid at a given check time.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Tests whether a specific date falls within the recurrence rule constraints.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes this recurrence rule from persistent storage.

methods.name: getNextFreq
methods.description: Computes the next frequency-based date from a starting point.

methods.name: validByRule
methods.description: Validates whether a date complies with 'by' rules like bySecond, byDay, byMonthDay, etc.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Determines whether a string starts with a numeric sign or digit.

methods.name: getDailyNumber
methods.description: Extracts numeric component from a day rule string.

methods.name: getDailyString
methods.description: Extracts the non-numeric part of a day rule string.

methods.name: getCalendarDay
methods.description: Converts weekday string abbreviations to Calendar day constants.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key string of the rule entity.

methods.name: makeRule
methods.description: Static factory methods to create new RecurrenceRule instances with specified frequency, interval, count, and end time.
